name: Actively
description: Win more deals with Actively inside Claude by directly accessing your always-on per account agents that help you drive the next best action. Actively AI's per-account agents are synthesizing across all of your internal context (ex. CRM data, call transcripts, emails) and external signals to drive actionable intelligence. Designed for SDRs, AEs, AMs, and revenue leaders who need deep, contextual account knowledge, from meeting prep and deal strategy to territory prioritization, directly inside Claude.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Actively to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Actively to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.actively.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Actively MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Actively lists 13 MCP tools, including generate_smart_fields, get_agent_decisions, get_agent_decisions_sections, get_agent_memory, get_agent_memory_sections, get_bulk_agent_decisions, get_bulk_agent_memory, get_recent_account_activity, get_smart_field_schemas, get_workflow_instructions, list_workflows, and lookup_accounts.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Actively?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Actively in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
Actively requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Actively is developed by Taurus Labs, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
